description: 대전광역시 서구_연도별 하천 현황 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시 서구. 대전광역시 서구의 연도별 하천 현황 데이터는 지역 내 하천 관리의 변화를 연도 단위로 추적하기 위한 기초 정보로, 연별, 하천수, 총연장, 요개수, 기개수, 미개수, 개수율 등을 포함하고. Coverage: 대전광역시 서구. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시 서구. Its tags are 하천수, 하천길이, 개수율, 하천현황, 연도별개수율. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
